Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

The Necromancer's carry build this season, and the most genuinely one-button build in the repo. Lord of Hatred's Hematolagnia key passive converts Blood Wave from an Ultimate into a Core skill - no cooldown, an Essence cost instead - and Kessime's Legacy then fires two waves per cast from both sides while pulling monsters in, so the old orb-pickup-and-reset gameplay is gone entirely. The multiplier engine is Overpower: you dump stacks with Blood Lance and regain them casting Blood Wave, which re-triggers the Bloodbath legendary node and the Dominate glyph. Cross-checked, and the sources genuinely disagree about how good that is: Maxroll's overall endgame list rates Blood Wave A, Maxroll's push list rates it A, Icy Veins rates it S, and TierListHQ's fresher 3.1.2 snapshot rates the class A with the comment that Blood Wave 'overperforms' but has 'limited depth behind it'. Two honest warnings. First, resource: the guide admits 'early on resource management can be an issue since Blood Wave as a core skill is very resource hungry', which is why the affix priorities below are dominated by Essence Regeneration and Resource Cost Reduction until Ring of Starless Skies lands. Second, and more serious, the endgame survivability package leans on a bug the guide states outright - 'Embattled Aspect makes your fortify healing instant (it is a bug)' - and pairs it with Endurant Faith so a finished character 'can feel quite immortal'. Treat that tech as volatile: it is the obvious patch target, and the build is still fine without it, just squishier. The guide author lists no cons beyond early gearing, which is worth reading as enthusiasm rather than as evidence.

Rotation
  1. Open on a small pull, casting Blood Wave until Resolve reaches roughly 10 stacks, then push the floor.
  2. Steady state: Blood Lance from range before every pack to dump Overpower, Bone Prison before the pack reaches you, Corpse Tendrils for Vulnerable, Blood Mist every eight seconds, Blood Wave held down throughout.
Variants

Leveling — Sever to teleport onto a pack, which also drops a corpse; Blood Mist eats that corpse for the Flesh Eater legendary node and teleports you again. Blood Lance from range to dump Overpower stacks, then hold Blood Wave to regain them - you have to spend before you can gain when you are at capacity. Bone Prison on anything that survives, for the attack speed. Weave Reap when Essence runs dry.
Move on when Kessime's Legacy equipped. The guide's own line is 'once you get a good Kessime's Legacy, the true power of the build will be revealed' - before it you cast one wave, after it you cast two and the build pulls monsters into them for you.

Early Endgame — The same loop, but most of it is now automatic. Curses run themselves: the Wat rune applies Decrepify, Life Tap generates Blood Orbs, and the Teb rune spends them on Iron Maiden, which is what applies Vulnerable. So you rotate Sever and Blood Mist for movement as Blood Mist comes off cooldown, and otherwise hold Blood Wave. Bone Prison on anything tanky - the guide notes Blood Wave 'one shots most t12 stuff' but that Bone Prison 'increases your DPS significantly' on the rest.
Move on when Ring of Starless Skies crafted. The guide names it the top crafting priority because 'it will solve most of your resource issues, and increase your damage' - and the Resource Cost Reduction requirement drops from over 25% to over 15% the moment it lands.

Late Endgame — Identical to the early endgame - Sever and Blood Mist to move, Blood Lance to dump Overpower, Blood Wave held down, Bone Prison on cooldown for tanky targets. What changes here is the gear, not the gameplay: this is where the Aspect swap onto boots and the amulet transfiguration land.
Move on when Ring of Starless Skies, Banished Lord's Talisman and Red Blessing all online, and you are ready to rebuild the character around 100% block chance and Resolve stacking - which is a different gear set, not a different rotation.

Pushing — Read the guide's warning first, because it is the difference between a run and a death: 'Decrepify is how you generate Resolve stacks via Resolve modifier. But when you start your pit/tower run, you have no stacks. If you engage big packs you will insta die.' So open on a small pull, cast Blood Wave until Resolve reaches roughly 10 stacks, and only then push the floor. Steady state: Blood Lance from range before every pack for Bloodbath's second half and Disobedience's damage reduction, Bone Prison before the pack reaches you, Corpse Tendrils for Vulnerable and Flesh Eater, Blood Mist every eight seconds, Blood Wave held down throughout - Overpower stays pinned at 11 on its own once it is running.

Stat requirements
  • Starter: 10 - 12 Essence Regeneration
  • Starter: >18% Resource Cost Reduction
  • Starter: >50% Attack Speed with Ferocity stacks
  • Midgame: >15 Essence Regeneration
  • Midgame: >25% Resource Cost Reduction
  • Midgame: >60% Critical Strike Chance
  • Midgame: >50% Attack Speed with Ferocity stacks
  • Endgame: >15 Essence Regeneration
  • Endgame: >15% Resource Cost Reduction
  • Endgame: >70% Critical Strike Chance
  • Endgame: >50% Attack Speed with Ferocity stacks
  • Push: >70% Critical Strike Chance
  • Push: 100% block chance
  • Push: >=50% Attack Speed with Ferocity stacks
Lootfilter

Blood Wave Necromancer — Maxroll Light / Medium / Strict (in-guide import codes) — View Filter

maxroll.gg

The guide ships its own filters as import codes in its Loot Filter section rather than as a permalink, in three strictness tiers. These are the exact-match option. No Blood-Wave-specific filter exists on the community filter sites; the closest is https://diablo4lootfilter.com/filters/lancewave-necromancer-full-endgame-pit-135-d4-loot-filter, a LanceWave (Blood Lance / Blood Wave hybrid) endgame filter that shares Kessime's Legacy and the Blood affix pool but is not tuned to this build's Essence-regen and Lucky-Hit-restore priorities. Preview either before importing.

Uniques
  • pants The build's enabler and the first thing to chase. Target-farm Andariel, and gamble pants at the vendor in parallel - the guide's own instruction is 'Gamble pants to acquire Kessime's Legacy. They also drop from Andariel's.' The plain Unique is fine: the guide says the Mythic upgrade 'doesn't provide a significant benefit'. Where →
  • ring 1 Mythic Unique, and the guide's crafting priority #1 because it solves the build's resource problem outright. Rare drop from any lair boss, or craft it in the Horadric Cube with Pandemonium Fragments - remembering that only one Cube-crafted Mythic can be equipped at a time. Where →
  • amulet Mythic Unique, crafting priority #2 for the endgame variant. General Unique Pool - any lair boss can drop it - or Horadric Cube conversion. Interchangeable with Red Blessing between the amulet and the charm slot; the guide prefers this one on the amulet because 'Banished Lord's Talisman has better affixes'. Where →
  • amulet Mythic Unique, and the push variant only - it displaces Banished Lord's Talisman there. General Unique Pool or Horadric Cube. The guide is blunt about the trade: it 'makes surviving more of a challenge but damage gain is so significant that it is worth it', and it keeps Aspect of Untimely Death live because you are constantly losing and regaining Life. Where →

How to run them

The guide publishes two pairings and switches between them. While you are still gearing it hires Aldkin, purely for the 15% Critical Strike Chance and the early sustain - 'getting critical strike chance to 100% is not as easy especially during the early game'. From the midgame on it hires Subo instead, for map visibility and a 25% Critical Damage multiplier, which is what the recorded tree above is. The Reinforcement never changes: Raheir on Bastion, 'great for survivability'. Icy Veins dissents and hires Varyana; Maxroll is the construction source here and its own author swaps mercenaries with progression, so the honest reading is that the hire is a tuning knob and Raheir/Bastion is the fixed part.

Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

The Necromancer's carry build this season, and the most genuinely one-button build in the repo. Lord of Hatred's Hematolagnia key passive converts Blood Wave from an Ultimate into a Core skill - no cooldown, an Essence cost instead - and Kessime's Legacy then fires two waves per cast from both sides while pulling monsters in, so the old orb-pickup-and-reset gameplay is gone entirely. The multiplier engine is Overpower: you dump stacks with Blood Lance and regain them casting Blood Wave, which re-triggers the Bloodbath legendary node and the Dominate glyph. Cross-checked, and the sources genuinely disagree about how good that is: Maxroll's overall endgame list rates Blood Wave A, Maxroll's push list rates it A, Icy Veins rates it S, and TierListHQ's fresher 3.1.2 snapshot rates the class A with the comment that Blood Wave 'overperforms' but has 'limited depth behind it'. Two honest warnings. First, resource: the guide admits 'early on resource management can be an issue since Blood Wave as a core skill is very resource hungry', which is why the affix priorities below are dominated by Essence Regeneration and Resource Cost Reduction until Ring of Starless Skies lands. Second, and more serious, the endgame survivability package leans on a bug the guide states outright - 'Embattled Aspect makes your fortify healing instant (it is a bug)' - and pairs it with Endurant Faith so a finished character 'can feel quite immortal'. Treat that tech as volatile: it is the obvious patch target, and the build is still fine without it, just squishier. The guide author lists no cons beyond early gearing, which is worth reading as enthusiasm rather than as evidence.

Rotation
  1. Open on a small pull, casting Blood Wave until Resolve reaches roughly 10 stacks, then push the floor.
  2. Steady state: Blood Lance from range before every pack to dump Overpower, Bone Prison before the pack reaches you, Corpse Tendrils for Vulnerable, Blood Mist every eight seconds, Blood Wave held down throughout.
Variants

Leveling — Sever to teleport onto a pack, which also drops a corpse; Blood Mist eats that corpse for the Flesh Eater legendary node and teleports you again. Blood Lance from range to dump Overpower stacks, then hold Blood Wave to regain them - you have to spend before you can gain when you are at capacity. Bone Prison on anything that survives, for the attack speed. Weave Reap when Essence runs dry.
Move on when Kessime's Legacy equipped. The guide's own line is 'once you get a good Kessime's Legacy, the true power of the build will be revealed' - before it you cast one wave, after it you cast two and the build pulls monsters into them for you.

Early Endgame — The same loop, but most of it is now automatic. Curses run themselves: the Wat rune applies Decrepify, Life Tap generates Blood Orbs, and the Teb rune spends them on Iron Maiden, which is what applies Vulnerable. So you rotate Sever and Blood Mist for movement as Blood Mist comes off cooldown, and otherwise hold Blood Wave. Bone Prison on anything tanky - the guide notes Blood Wave 'one shots most t12 stuff' but that Bone Prison 'increases your DPS significantly' on the rest.
Move on when Ring of Starless Skies crafted. The guide names it the top crafting priority because 'it will solve most of your resource issues, and increase your damage' - and the Resource Cost Reduction requirement drops from over 25% to over 15% the moment it lands.

Late Endgame — Identical to the early endgame - Sever and Blood Mist to move, Blood Lance to dump Overpower, Blood Wave held down, Bone Prison on cooldown for tanky targets. What changes here is the gear, not the gameplay: this is where the Aspect swap onto boots and the amulet transfiguration land.
Move on when Ring of Starless Skies, Banished Lord's Talisman and Red Blessing all online, and you are ready to rebuild the character around 100% block chance and Resolve stacking - which is a different gear set, not a different rotation.

Pushing — Read the guide's warning first, because it is the difference between a run and a death: 'Decrepify is how you generate Resolve stacks via Resolve modifier. But when you start your pit/tower run, you have no stacks. If you engage big packs you will insta die.' So open on a small pull, cast Blood Wave until Resolve reaches roughly 10 stacks, and only then push the floor. Steady state: Blood Lance from range before every pack for Bloodbath's second half and Disobedience's damage reduction, Bone Prison before the pack reaches you, Corpse Tendrils for Vulnerable and Flesh Eater, Blood Mist every eight seconds, Blood Wave held down throughout - Overpower stays pinned at 11 on its own once it is running.

Lootfilter

Blood Wave Necromancer — Maxroll Light / Medium / Strict (in-guide import codes) — View Filter

maxroll.gg

The guide ships its own filters as import codes in its Loot Filter section rather than as a permalink, in three strictness tiers. These are the exact-match option. No Blood-Wave-specific filter exists on the community filter sites; the closest is https://diablo4lootfilter.com/filters/lancewave-necromancer-full-endgame-pit-135-d4-loot-filter, a LanceWave (Blood Lance / Blood Wave hybrid) endgame filter that shares Kessime's Legacy and the Blood affix pool but is not tuned to this build's Essence-regen and Lucky-Hit-restore priorities. Preview either before importing.

Uniques
  • pants The build's enabler and the first thing to chase. Target-farm Andariel, and gamble pants at the vendor in parallel - the guide's own instruction is 'Gamble pants to acquire Kessime's Legacy. They also drop from Andariel's.' The plain Unique is fine: the guide says the Mythic upgrade 'doesn't provide a significant benefit'. Where →
  • ring 1 Mythic Unique, and the guide's crafting priority #1 because it solves the build's resource problem outright. Rare drop from any lair boss, or craft it in the Horadric Cube with Pandemonium Fragments - remembering that only one Cube-crafted Mythic can be equipped at a time. Where →
  • amulet Mythic Unique, crafting priority #2 for the endgame variant. General Unique Pool - any lair boss can drop it - or Horadric Cube conversion. Interchangeable with Red Blessing between the amulet and the charm slot; the guide prefers this one on the amulet because 'Banished Lord's Talisman has better affixes'. Where →
  • amulet Mythic Unique, and the push variant only - it displaces Banished Lord's Talisman there. General Unique Pool or Horadric Cube. The guide is blunt about the trade: it 'makes surviving more of a challenge but damage gain is so significant that it is worth it', and it keeps Aspect of Untimely Death live because you are constantly losing and regaining Life. Where →

BasicShadow

Rank 1/15

Generate Essence: 15

Lucky Hit Chance: 30%

Sweep an ethereal scythe in front of you, dealing 50% damage.

Modifiers

  • Essence GenerationReap generates 2 additional Essence per enemy hit.

Shadow Damage

Blood Wave

UltimateBlood

Rank 15/15

Cooldown: 50 seconds

Lucky Hit Chance: 50%

Conjure a tidal wave of blood that deals 500% damage and Knocks Back enemies.

Modifiers

  • OverpowerCasting Blood Wave overfills your Overpower by 2.
  • HematolagniaBlood Wave becomes a Core Skill, has no Cooldown, but costs 50 Essence. Blood Wave conjures a shorter wave that deals 300% damage and no longer Knocks Back enemies.
  • Damage BonusBlood Wave deals 30%[x] increased damage while you are Fortified.
Physical Damage

Blood Lance

CoreBlood

Rank 14/15

Essence Cost: 15

Lucky Hit Chance: 50%

Throw a blood lance, dealing 130% to an enemy that ricochets to another enemy. Enemies hit are lanced for 3 seconds.

When Blood Lance hits an enemy, it deals damage to all other lanced enemies.

Modifiers

  • OverpowerBlood Lance consumes 2 stacks of Overpower to throw an additional lance, dealing 50% of normal damage.
  • FortifyBlood Lance Fortifies you for 4% of your Maximum Life ({x}) if it hits an enemy already lanced.
  • Festering WoundBlood Lance becomes a Darkness Skill and deals Shadow damage. Enemies hit are permanently lanced and the lance deals 80% Corrupting damage per second to them.
Physical Damage

Sever

CoreShadow

Rank 1/15

Essence Cost: 20

Lucky Hit Chance: 40%

A specter of you charges forward, dealing 60% damage, then attacks with its scythe, dealing 100% damage.

Modifiers

  • Cost ReductionSever's Essence cost is reduced by 4.
  • Inexorable ReaperSever is also a Mobility Skill that dashes you forward to attack instead.
  • Crowd Control and Corpse GenerationSever Slows enemies by 40% for 3 seconds and forms a Corpse.
Shadow Damage

Bone Prison

MacabreBone

Rank 15/15

Cooldown: 15 seconds

Unearth a prison of bone with {x} Life that surrounds the target area for 6 seconds.

Modifiers

  • Essence GenerationCasting Bone Prison generates 50 Essence. Trapping a Boss generates an additional 25 Essence.
  • Life ImprisonmentBone Prison becomes a Blood Skill, casting the prison around you. While standing within it your Essence Generation and Cast Speed are increased by 20%, but it drains 5% of your Maximum Life every second.
  • VulnerableBone Prison makes enemies Vulnerable for 8 seconds.

Blood Mist

MacabreBlood

Rank 1/15

Cooldown: 24 seconds

Lucky Hit Chance: 9%

Disperse into a bloody mist, becoming Immune for 3 seconds. You deal 420% damage to enemies and Heal for 6.0% of your Maximum Life ({x}) over the duration.

Modifiers

  • Movement SpeedBlood Mist increases your Movement Speed by 30%[x] for 3 seconds.
  • Blood RushBlood Mist is now also a Mobility Skill and its Cooldown is reduced to 8 seconds. Instead of dispersing you into a bloody mist, Blood Mist consumes a nearby corpse to teleport you to the target location and grants Unstoppable for 3.0 seconds.

Rank 15/15

Cooldown: 15 seconds

Unearth a prison of bone with {x} Life that surrounds the target area for 6 seconds.

Modifiers

  • Essence GenerationCasting Bone Prison generates 50 Essence. Trapping a Boss generates an additional 25 Essence.
  • Life ImprisonmentBone Prison becomes a Blood Skill, casting the prison around you. While standing within it your Essence Generation and Cast Speed are increased by 20%, but it drains 5% of your Maximum Life every second.
  • ResolveBone Prison grants 1 stack of Resolve for each enemy trapped.

Corpse Generation

UpgradeReap

Rank 1/3

Reap forms a Corpse under the first enemy hit.

Essence Generation

UpgradeReap

Rank 1/3

Reap generates 2 additional Essence per enemy hit.

Cull The Weak

UpgradeReap

Rank 1/3

Reap becomes a Blood Skill that deals 62.5% Physical damage.

Reap will Execute enemies and has a 50% chance to form a Blood Orb if they are killed by it.

Overpower

UpgradeBlood Lance

Rank 1/3

Blood Lance consumes 2 stacks of Overpower to throw an additional lance, dealing 50% of normal damage.

Fortify

UpgradeBlood Lance

Rank 1/3

Blood Lance Fortifies you for 4% of your Maximum Life ({x}) if it hits an enemy already lanced.

Festering Wound

UpgradeBlood Lance

Rank 1/3

Blood Lance becomes a Darkness Skill and deals Shadow damage.

Enemies hit are permanently lanced and the lance deals 80% Corrupting damage per second to them.

Critical Strike

UpgradeBlood Mist

Rank 1/3

Blood Mist grants 5%[+] Critical Strike Chance for 5 seconds after it ends.

Blood Rush

UpgradeBlood Mist

Rank 1/3

Blood Mist is now also a Mobility Skill and its Cooldown is reduced to 8 seconds.

Instead of dispersing you into a bloody mist, Blood Mist consumes a nearby corpse to teleport you to the target location and grants Unstoppable for 3.0 seconds.

Vulnerable and Slow

UpgradeBlood Mist

Rank 1/3

Blood Mist makes enemies Vulnerable and Slows them by 70% for 4 seconds.

Essence Generation

UpgradeBone Prison

Rank 1/3

Casting Bone Prison generates 50 Essence. Trapping a Boss generates an additional 25 Essence.

Life Imprisonment

UpgradeBone Prison

Rank 1/3

Bone Prison becomes a Blood Skill, casting the prison around you.

While standing within it your Essence Generation and Cast Speed are increased by 20%, but it drains 5% of your Maximum Life every second.

Resolve

UpgradeBone Prison

Rank 1/3

Bone Prison grants 1 stack of Resolve for each enemy trapped.

Ferocity and Overpower

UpgradeIron Maiden

Rank 1/3

Lucky Hit: Enemies hit while afflicted with Iron Maiden have up to a 15% chance to randomly grant 1 stack of Ferocity or Overpower.

Blood Maiden

UpgradeIron Maiden

Rank 1/3

Iron Maiden is also a Blood Skill, causing enemies damaged by it to have a 5% chance to form a Blood Orb.

Casting Iron Maiden picks up 4 Blood Orbs in the target area and causes them to burst for 150% damage.

Execute and Fortify

UpgradeIron Maiden

Rank 1/3

Enemies afflicted with Iron Maiden will be Executed.

You are Fortified for 5% of your Maximum Life ({x}) when an enemy dies while afflicted with Iron Maiden.

Resolve

UpgradeDecrepify

Rank 1/3

Lucky Hit: Enemies hit while afflicted with Decrepify have up to a 25% chance to grant 1 stack of Resolve.

Life Tap

UpgradeDecrepify

Rank 1/3

Decrepify is also a Blood Skill, healing for 10.0% of your Maximum Life ({x}) whenever you hit an enemy afflicted with it, up to once a second.

Enemies that die while afflicted with Decrepify have a 20% chance to form a Blood Orb.

Cooldown Reduction

UpgradeDecrepify

Rank 1/3

Lucky Hit: Enemies hit while afflicted with Decrepify have up to a 15% chance to reduce a random active Cooldown by 1 second.

Critical Strike Chance

UpgradeCorpse Tendrils

Rank 1/3

You gain an additional 5%[+] increased Critical Strike Chance for 6 seconds against enemies damaged by Corpse Tendrils.

C

Jaws Of Death

UpgradeCorpse Tendrils

Rank 1/3

Corpse Tendrils now deals 100% damage and no longer has a delay before Pulling in enemies.

Vulnerable

UpgradeCorpse Tendrils

Rank 1/3

Corpse Tendrils makes enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

Overpower

UpgradeBlood Wave

Rank 1/3

Casting Blood Wave overfills your Overpower by 2.

Hematolagnia

UpgradeBlood Wave

Rank 1/3

Blood Wave becomes a Core Skill, has no Cooldown, but costs 50 Essence.

Blood Wave conjures a shorter wave that deals 300% damage and no longer Knocks Back enemies.

Damage Bonus

UpgradeBlood Wave

Rank 1/3

Blood Wave deals 30%[x] increased damage while you are Fortified.
